column1: # Raw-limb identity of Rgemm_NT_omp vs the serial NT body it replaced (review2 §8.4).
# v2, 2026-08-09: SUPERSEDES the v1 table of 2026-08-08, which advertised '~20% structural
# zeros' but placed NONE -- its generator documented [-1,1) and returned [0,2), so the zero
# predicate (lcg() < -0.6) never fired (review2 §10.1). v1 also labelled gate_open from the
# work term alone, marking 27 n=1 rows open although production also requires n >= 2.
# gate_open = the EXACT production predicate: m*n*k >= MPACK_OMP_MIN_GEMM_WORK (512) AND
#          n >= MPACK_OMP_MIN_GEMM_WIDTH (2). 74 of 135 cases open, 61 deliberately serial.
# zeros_in_B = structural zeros actually placed by an independent predicate (~20%),
#          28960 across the 135 cases -- the zero-skip branch IS exercised.
# Self-tests run before the cases and abort the harness on failure: fill range spans
#          negatives, zero predicate fires at rate, a 1e-60 limb perturbation IS detected,
#          a padding write IS detected. A comparison that cannot fail proves nothing.
# 135 cases per thread count, memcmp over every qd_real limb: 0 failures at 1, 4, 8 threads.
